excluded_sources.technical_rationale: Although genuine Python AST parsing successfully extracts all 6 SQLite tools, their exact line spans (lines 235-297), and their inputSchema AST dictionary literals, the companion TypeScript GitHub MCP source (CAND-010) cannot resolve its external Zod schema imports without unpinned dependencies. To prevent asymmetric cohort representation and adhere to benchmark protocol rules prohibiting hand-maintained metadata, both MCP sources are excluded from the candidate operation universe and ranking outputs.

CAND-010 delegates tool input schemas to zodToJsonSchema(CreateOrUpdateFileSchema, etc.), which are imported from ./schemas.js. Because ./schemas.js is an external unpinned file absent from the frozen raw snapshot, genuine static AST resolution of input-schema properties, required fields, and depth cannot be achieved from index.ts alone. In accordance with benchmark protocol rules strictly prohibiting hand-maintained metadata or unpinned crawls, this source is excluded from the active candidate operation universe.
